cohort: 41 infants with clubfoot who visited the orthopaedics department of Chirayu Medical College and hospitals, Bhopal, between March 2022 and December 2022, including 27 infants under six months, five between six and twelve months, and nine between one and two years of age, with 25 unilateral and 16 bilateral cases, and a gender distribution of 26 boys and 15 girls.
finding: The Ponseti method for clubfoot treatment resulted in a significant improvement in Pirani scores (from a mean of 3.46 to 0.03), with 82% excellent, 12% good, and 4% fair outcomes.
